node: HBM memory stack, interface IP, and memory-controller ecosystem
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the HBM interface / memory-stack node found three US-listed names with plausible direct or second-order exposure beyond obvious memory manufacturers. The cleanest underfollowed chokepoint candidates are Rambus for HBM / memory-interface IP and FormFactor for HBM wafer/probe-card test enablement. Amkor is included as a larger but still sub-mega-cap packaging/test infrastructure candidate because HBM adoption increases the importance of heterogeneous integration and advanced packaging. Micron, SK hynix, Samsung, NVIDIA, AMD, and TSMC remain reference anchors but are intentionally not used to fill this underfollowed discovery list.
